query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

LTX 2.5 lip sync: the LTX 2.3 pattern (audio encode -> latent mask -> audio latent) no longer produces synced mouth movement; modality/CFG/mask tweaks don't help.

desired.outcome: UCHIJ (C3) ported the 2.3 lipsync nodes to a native-node LTX 2.5 workflow that works: https://github.com/UCHIJ/LTX2.5-LipSync. Not confirmed by OP.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: UCHIJ (C3) ported the 2.3 lipsync nodes to a native-node LTX 2.5 workflow that works: https://github.com/UCHIJ/LTX2.5-LipSync. Not confirmed by OP.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Recognize the LTX 2.3 audio-encode/latent-mask lipsync wiring is stale for LTX 2.5 and rebuild the lipsync path with native nodes (per UCHIJ's ported repo).
